text:
Alex: Heads-up — drafting the release notes for v1.12.0 + planning internal announce. We have the DB migration flag that needs pinning. Thoughts on timing?
Sana: prefer a 15:00 PT change window tomorrow. less traffic. :+1:
Ben: canary at 14:30 PT, full rollout 15:00 PT. rollback window 30m after rollout.
Jamie: note — the migration will add a new column and a short backfill. It's reversible but fragile on high QPS. Recommend conservative pin and a soft-launch.
Priya: for internal announce, split audience: eng + ops at T-1h, wider company at T+2h with degradation notes.
Alex: agree. Can we pin to commit sha: a1b2c3d for the initial rollout? That lets ops force a quick rollback to the exact binary.
Ben: yes, pin to a1b2c3d. Deploybot: please accept pin and set canary percentage to 5%.
deploybot: @Ben acknowledged. Pin set to a1b2c3d. Canary 5% scheduled at 1753219000 (14:30 PT). Full rollout scheduled at 1753219800 (15:00 PT).
Sana: copy for internal note draft: "Planned v1.12.0 deploy (DB migration). Canary 14:30 PT, rollout 15:00 PT. If you see increased latency, alert #eng-oncall and append tag "migration-impact""
Marta (Legal): quick Q — any user-facing changes that require disclosure or delay for privacy review?
Jamie: no user-visible UX changes, just schema and internal metrics. No PII touched.
Marta (Legal): OK, I'm good. No hold from legal.
Priya: I'll prepare two short snippets: one ops-facing (with rollback steps + relevant runbook link) and one broad (what to expect for non-technical teams).
Alex: include explicit rollback criteria: CPU > 85% on db-primary for 5m OR error rate > 2% for 3m. If triggered, rollback to pinned sha a1b2c3d-previous (we'll keep standby build).
Ben: canary-bot will monitor, but ops should be ready to trigger manual rollback. I'll be on standby.
Sana: who wants to post internal announce at T-1h? I can do ops and eng. Priya can send the wider company note at T+2h.
Alex: perfect. Last: add a short FAQ line about pinned version and where to find the rollback button in Console. Priya, can you add that?
Priya: yep. Draft coming in 10m.
Alex: thanks — will mark release note draft as "internal-review" in the doc and tag @Ben @Sana for approvals. :eyes:
Ben: ack.
Jamie: ack.
deploybot: Reminder: keep CI artifacts for pinned builds for 7 days. Backups for migration run at 14:45 PT.
Sana: all set. leaning toward conservative approach given the backfill. Will update the thread with the final announce copy. :slightly_smiling_face:
Priya: posting ops snippet in a minute, will include runbook link and deploybot rollback command example:
```
# rollback example
deploybot rollback --to a1b2c3d-previous --reason "migration anomaly"
```
Alex: Great. Closing this draft thread — final update will be the T-1h announce and the deploybot canary heartbeat.
